name: python-text-diff
title: Unified diff that proves it can be applied
blurb: A unified diff that parses, applies, and refuses to guess: hunks are remeasured against the text they land on, a hunk that matches twice is an error rather than a coin flip, fuzz is reported instead of silent, missing final newlines survive, and `check` proves apply(a, diff(a, b)) is b.
default_description: A unified diff reader and applier that treats a misplaced hunk as an error, not a guess.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install -e . pytest ruff
